title: FailureTaxonomy
description: Central failure taxonomy mapping error classes to retryability and deterministic escalation paths.

categories.description: Tool or network call exceeded timeout threshold.
categories.escalation: Worker retries locally first up to bounded attempt limit with original idempotency_key.
Worker retries locally with exponential backoff.

categories.description: Connection reset or network drop mid-call.
Malformed CapabilityRequest or parameter schema violation.
categories.escalation: Immediate escalation to Agent; do not resend invalid request.

categories.description: Grant missing, expired, revoked, or security authorization denied.
categories.escalation: Immediate escalation to Human via Pulse.

categories.description: Denied at Space Kernel Admission Control before dispatch.
categories.escalation: Immediate escalation to Human; no dispatch attempted.

categories.description: Requested capability, resource, node, or artifact does not exist.
categories.escalation: Escalate to Agent or Orchestrator for replan.
